raw: {"analysis": "Response ZPH deviates from the explicit instruction to automatically roll back on CPU throttling alerts, instead proposing human-gated rollback, which could delay response to latency spikes. It also reduces the flaky check retry to once, contrary to the known practice of two retries. Response JHX follows the automatic rollback instruction, uses the standard two retries for the flaky check, and includes a canary health gate, aligning better with the requester's priorities. Both respect namespace exclusions and cost constraints, but JHX more faithfully implements the stated requirements.", "verdict": "JHX"}
